entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-10-26
entry.content:
Azure.Core_1.64.0

1.64.0 (2026-10-26)

Features Added

  • Promoted AKS identity binding support in WorkloadIdentityCredential to general availability. WorkloadIdentityCredentialOptions.IsAzureProxyEnabled no longer requires suppressing experimental diagnostic AZID0002. Identity binding remains opt-in and isn't supported by DefaultAzureCredential or ManagedIdentityCredential.

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed CA certificate reloads for an already-used Kubernetes token proxy in WorkloadIdentityCredential, so subsequent requests use the new CA without throwing or retaining the old trust configuration.

Azure.ResourceManager.CognitiveServices_1.7.0-beta.1

1.7.0-beta.1 (2026-10-26)

Features Added

  • Upgraded api-version to 2026-09-15-preview.

Breaking Changes

  • Compared to 1.6.0-beta.4, renamed CapabilitySettings to CognitiveServicesAgentCapabilitySettings, including references in account/project properties and model-factory methods.
  • Compared to 1.6.0-beta.4, changed CognitiveServicesClusterComputeProperties.SubnetArmId from string to Azure.Core.ResourceIdentifier.
  • Compared to 1.6.0-beta.4, changed CognitiveServicesManagedComputeDeploymentInfo.DeploymentId and ProjectId from string to Azure.Core.ResourceIdentifier.
